correctness.rationale: The verifier reconstructs \(H(2,4)\), all \(808\) faces, and all \(2736\) Hasse covers. The \(375\)-pair matching is checked acyclic on the complete oriented Hasse graph and leaves Morse vector \((1,1,56)\). For \(H_1\), the full integral cycle lattice of \(K_{16}\) is expressed in a \(105\)-element fundamental-cycle basis. Triangle boundaries give a \(105\times320\) integer matrix \(B\). A \(104\)-minor has determinant \(1\), a \(105\)-minor has determinant \(-2\), and \(\operatorname{rank}(B\bmod 2)=104\), so the Smith form has \(104\) unit factors and one factor \(2\). Thus \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z/2\mathbb Z\). The \(2\)-dimensional Morse model and Euler characteristic \(56\) then force \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^{55}\) and vanishing above degree \(2\). The claim states no stronger homotopy decomposition.
